newsitem.title: GREECE: GSEE, PAPASTRATOS UNION MEET ON STRATEGY.
newsitem.headline: GSEE, PAPASTRATOS UNION MEET ON STRATEGY.

text.p: Representatives of Greece's largest labour grouping, GSEE, met tabacco union leaders and workers at the Papastratos tobacco company to map out a common strategy for dealing with problems at the firm, GSEE said in a statement.
The union leaders discussed the situation at Papastratos where management is trying to restructure production, GSEE said.
All participants agreed to do everything possible to stop the firm from altering the present working relationships at the company, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
